objective: Maximize relevant account recall without pretending the open-world market universe is complete.
input: Product Adapter(s) + territory + access policy + discovery budget + optional known-positive benchmark
output: Candidate seeds with discovery provenance for entity resolution; never a qualified-account label.
dedupe_rule: Dedupe conservatively by domain/registry/alias evidence; unresolved brand-parent/subsidiary relationships go to entity resolution instead of forced merge.
stop_rule: Stop only after planned source-family coverage is acceptable AND known-positive recall target is met when benchmark exists AND marginal unique-account yield has plateaued; otherwise record a source/budget gap. Open-world runs must not claim total completeness.
hard_fails: one source family treated as the market
brand/subsidiary duplicates forced into one account without evidence
search absence used as account non-existence
OPEN_WORLD_NOT_COMPLETE omitted when no closed sampling frame exists
